column1: # regenerated: 2026-10-05 (#5132 — light_count_spot row added; light rows
# re-captured in ONE renderer-static run per game, engine f75ac66cb)
# RT-2026-09-29-06: the schema had no spot-light row, so the b9e961eeb
# Point->Spot reclassification read as a point-count regression on FO4.
# REQUIRED_METRICS and the skill's Phase 3 table gain light_count_spot
# (exact, same source: kind= rows in light.dump). Fresh tallies: point
# and directional are UNCHANGED on every fixture (30/11/680/8/28 point,
# 0 directional); spot is 0 everywhere but FO4's 5. The 5 FO4 spots were
# spot-checked against their LIGH records via
# `cargo run -p byroredux-plugin --example spot_light_census --
# Fallout4.esm InstituteBioScience`: the cell authors 6 spot placements,
# the five defaultLight*Spot* records (fov 90 -> engine cone_cos 0.7071)
# classify Spot, and the sixth (KlaxonLightGlowNS, fov 80, flags 0x4001)
# stays Point — 685 = 680 + 5, no light lost. Draw/skin/pose/texture
# rows re-verified bit-identical to the held baselines in the same run;
# only the advisory fps rows moved (wall-clock, never a finding).
# Oblivion note: entities_total read 928 this pass against the held 929
# (-1 body, inside the +/-2 % band; stats/bench cross-check agreed at 928).
# Held then; adopted 2026-10-07 (#5236) so every row below comes from this
# ONE capture. The -1 vs the 09-30 #5125 capture matches #5189's artifact
# no-spawn below (the surviving __MAX_Default_Light carrier stops spawning
# a scene light entity with it) — consistent, not separately bisected.
# This run is also the live confirmation of the light_count_directional
# history: #5123 took it 2 -> 1, #5189 took it 1 -> 0, and this capture
# measured 0 directional live. #5236 un-buried both blocks (they sat under
# the 09-16 narrative, and the 09-30 block's text still claimed the row
# "stays 1") and reordered this file newest-first.
# regenerated: 2026-10-03 (#5189 — CONTRACT-DERIVED regen, not live-captured:
# light_count_directional 1 -> 0. The surviving artifact emitter was one half
# of earshuman.nif's `__MAX_Default_Light` ± pair, kept by #5123's
# first-carrier-wins de-dup. Gamebryo scopes the pair to its own subtree
# (NiNode effects, pre-10.1.0.0), it has no LIGH authority, and every vanilla
# instance is the exporter artifact (48 Oblivion carriers, 0 in FNV/FO3), so
# the artifact no longer spawns as a scene light at all.
# Confirmed live by the 2026-10-05 #5132 capture above (0 directional).
# regenerated: 2026-09-30 (#5125 — every row re-captured in ONE renderer-static run, engine 60cd7028c)
# Camera move, not a renderer change. `b9e961eeb` replaced the interior spawn
# door/bbox heuristic with a ladder (COCMarkerHeading, then the partner door's
# XTEL), and renderer-static holds the camera at the player's eyes on that
# pose, so the frustum and the whole draw split moved. Bisected by the
# 2026-09-29 runtime audit (RT-3): the draw rows are bit-identical to the
# previous baseline at `cb44d99f6` and move at `b9e961eeb` with entity and
# light counts identical. The new `bench_camera_pos` / `bench_camera_forward`
# rows make the pose part of the contract, so the next pose change fails as a
# pose change instead of reading as a batching regression.
# Pose reviewed from a HEAD screenshot before this regen: the partner-XTEL arrival faces a
# tapestry on a wall at close range, so raster is 20 and this cell still
# barely exercises raster batching (the old pose faced a wall too, subject
# distance 3.9 BU). The heading goes through the same Z-up conversion as the
# COCMarkerHeading poses, which face into their rooms on the other four games.
#   spawn: Interior spawn for 'ICMarketDistrictTheGildedCarafe': door arrival (partner XTEL) at (266.9, 262.8, -204.5)
#   draws 330/78b/5c raster 132 -> 335/18b/2c raster 20
# Carried with this regen and attributed per #5131's bisect (issue closed
# by that attribution): entities_total 745 -> 929 (+24.7 %) is moved by
# `a070baaad` (+177 measured in the audit's bisect; the baseline 745 vs
# `cb44d99f6`'s 757 was the known in-band creep) - this regen recorded 929
# against the audit capture's 934, a 5-entity capture-to-capture variance
# not separately attributed. light_count_directional stayed 1 at this regen
# (RT-2, #5123, fixed) — superseded 2026-10-03 by the #5189 block above
# (1 -> 0). skin_pool_live 4 -> 9 and the fps rows are advisory.
# regenerated: 2026-09-29 (#5123 — CONTRACT-DERIVED regen, not live-captured:
# light_count_directional 2 -> 1. The 2 measured both halves of Oblivion
# earshuman.nif's `__MAX_Default_Light` ± pair: #3557's de-dup allowlist
# compared case-sensitively against the lowercased dump name, so it matched
# nothing on the NPC/actor-part path (the audit even pinned the case
# sensitivity). The real NIF spelling is `__MAX_Default_Light`; with the
# allowlist now case-insensitive the de-dup collapses every later artifact
# load to the first emitter — 1 directional for this cell. The #5123 unit
# test pins the collapse (two earshuman loads -> 1 emitter). Next live
# audit run should confirm the row; entities_total also drops 5 (6 -> 1
# artifact emitters at the 9fcfdc3fc capture), inside the ±2% band.
# light_count_point stays 8. It is the count of `kind=Point` rows: this cell
# dumps `LightSource emitters: 10` = 8 point + 2 directional (#4419).
# entities_total 745 is unchanged since the 2026-09-13 #4124 regen below.
# regenerated: 2026-09-16 (#4417 — every row re-captured in ONE renderer-static run)
# Mode change, not a code change. capture.sh now pins `--bench-mode
# renderer-static` (authored camera, dt=0). Every row below this header's
# predecessors was captured with no --bench-mode, which the engine resolves to
# `system-live` (free camera, wall-clock dt). The two modes place the camera
# differently, so the frustum and the whole draw split differ. Same build:
#   system-live      draws=330/20b/2c raster=22
#   renderer-static  draws=330/78b/5c raster=132
# The system-live capture reproduced the previous draw rows exactly, so the
# draw-row move below is the camera, not a regression. The new `bench_mode`
# row makes the mode part of the contract. skin_pool_* now come from the
# bench: line's `skin=L/M+S` token, read at the measured frame. Draw-split
# invariant holds: 78 <= 132 <= 330, 5 <= 2 x 78.
# past the +/-2% band for the first time since the 2026-08-26 regen. The
# render-load contract was already untouched at the time of filing:
# bench_draws_cmds 325 -> 330 (+1.5%, inside x1.1), bench_draws_batches
# 20 -> 20 (exact), bench_draws_gpu_calls 2 -> 2 (exact),
# light_count_point/light_count_directional 8/2 (exact). Live-captured this
# session (`--game oblivion --cell ICMarketDistrictTheGildedCarafe
# --bench-frames 240 --bench-hold`, cross-checked: byro-dbg `stats` stream
# and the engine's own `bench:` line both report entities=745, agreeing with
# the issue's own numbers — same cell, not a mis-attributed capture, #3560)
# and additionally ran `world.owners` for a per-ECS-class breakdown the
# original filing didn't have: `tlas_instances` (the actual rendered-instance
# count, printed on the `bench:` line itself as `tlas=330`) is 330 — i.e. the
# rendering-visible instance set grew by exactly the same +5 the draw-command
# count already showed, not by ~40. The remaining growth sits in
# non-rendering classes the `bench:`/draw-split evidence cannot see directly
# (`physics_bodies`=156, `transform_rows`=716 vs `cell_root_rows`=743 — the
# gap between spawned entities and rendered instances). This is the same
# "more bodies, not more visible geometry" signature as every prior instance
# of this pattern (RT-3/#1705, RT-8/#3554), now confirmed at the ECS-class
# level rather than only via the draw split. A full per-commit `git bisect`
# across the ~816 commits since the 2026-08-26 regen (`d6e16c90`) to name the
# exact root-cause commit was NOT performed — each step would need its own
# live engine rebuild+rerun, out of this pipeline's `cargo test` scope (see
# CLAUDE.md's smoke-test note) — so the specific spawner responsible remains
# uncited. `tex_missing_all_slots` also dropped 8 -> 0 (informational, not
# gated) consistent with #3555/RT-9's facegen fallback fix having landed
# since the row was last held. `bench_draws_raster_cmds` also moved (133 ->
# 22); this metric only gates via a `>= 3000` threshold check (see SKILL.md
# §Phase 3), so the drop does not cross the branch this baseline exists to
# catch. All other rows held.
# regenerated: 2026-09-03 (#3660 — measured raster-prefix command count; other rows held)
# regenerated: 2026-08-26 (#3288 — first live re-run since 2026-08-06; see
# docs/audits/AUDIT_RUNTIME_2026-08-26.md)
# entities_total 701 -> 705 (+0.6%, inside the +/-2% band) and the draw split
# moved DOWN on both gated axes: batches 47 -> 20, gpu_calls 4 -> 2. Recapturing
# a cell whose gated metrics improved tightens the contract; this is the only
# one of the five baselines regenerated this pass. fnv / fo3 / skyrim_se each
# carry a metric past a gating threshold in the WRONG direction and were left
# stale on purpose, so the evidence survives (RT-2026-08-26-01/02/04).
# #3550/RT-4 — `tex_missing_unique_paths` split into `tex_missing_base_color`
# (strict gate, comparable across the #3349 metric-surface widening) and
# `tex_missing_all_slots` (informational). See
# `.claude/commands/audit-runtime/SKILL.md` §Phase 3.
# #3555/RT-9 — `tex_missing_base_color` was 1 (the only genuine tex_missing
# delta across all five 2026-08-30-audited cells): `facegen\ears\human\
# earshuman.dds` (and its `_n` sibling) missed. Root-caused against the real
# archives (not guessed) — there is no `facegen\` top-level folder anywhere
# in Oblivion's BSAs; three vanilla NIFs (`earshuman.nif`, `earshighelf.nif`,
# `earswoodelf.nif`) bake in a FaceGen SDK export-tool path instead of the
# real `textures\characters\imperial\earshuman.dds`. Fixed with a
# basename-fallback lookup gated on the `textures\facegen\` prefix
# (`byroredux/src/asset_provider/{archive,texture}.rs`). Verified end-to-end
# against the real archive
# (`cargo test -p byroredux --bin byroredux facegen_tool_path -- --ignored`,
# both the diffuse and `_n` sibling now resolve) — row regenerated to 0.
# #3556/RT-10 — `light_count_directional` was derived from the mere presence
# of a `CellLightingRes` block, so it read a constant `1` on all five games
# and could never fail (#3424). The engine now parses the real per-emitter
# dump (`5f970bae`). Oblivion measures 2 directional / 8 point emitters
# (the two synthetic directionals are RT-11's finding, not a regression
# here). Added the new `light_count_point` row and corrected
# `light_count_directional` to the measured value.
# bench_fps_* is advisory only under xvfb (RT-2 / #1701) — never gate on it.
# entities_total: +/-2% tolerance metric, not exact (#1705 / RT-3).
# skin_pool_live: advisory, not a hard gate — see skin_pool_max /
# skin_pool_overflow_attempts instead (#3553 / RT-7).
